arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
p=Path('/app/code.png').read_bytes()
h0=hashlib.sha256(p).digest()
for salt in [b'0000TBENCH-SALT', b'0000TBENCH-SALT', b'000TBENCH-SALT', b'0000TBENCH-SALT']:
    h=hashlib.sha256(h0+h0[:10]+salt).hexdigest()
    print(repr(salt), h)
print('h0',h0.hex())
PY
